verdict.rationale: Recurly's core product is built around recurring billing cycles that run automatically (subscription renewals, usage-based billing at cycle end, dunning email campaigns), which functions as a domain-specific recurring workflow engine, but it offers no general-purpose job/task scheduler an AI-native user could configure for arbitrary recurring workflows. Missing for 10: a generic scheduling/automation API or cron-like mechanism for arbitrary AI-driven tasks, and any evidence of AI-agent-triggered scheduling beyond built-in billing cycles.
